tools.name: search_wineries
tools.description: Search South African wineries listed on Sip by name or wine region. Returns name, region, description, rating and the Sip page URL.

tools.name: get_winery
tools.description: Get full public details for one winery on Sip (by slug or name), including tasting experiences (with ids) and how each one is booked. Use the experience id with `check_availability` and `get_booking_link`.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming wine events and festivals published on Sip, optionally filtered by wine region or date range.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List all South African wine regions covered by Sip, with a short description and how many wineries each one has.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: List bookable start times (South African time) for one tasting experience over the next days, using the same rules as sip-it.io's date picker.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Get a sip-it.io link that opens the booking form for a tasting, prefilled with date, time and party size. The guest completes the booking on Sip. For tastings not reserved through Sip, returns the winery's direct contact instead.
